general_rules: Hardcore Worlds uses the Hardcore Group Ironman death rules: treat every death as run-ending. Only Koschei's 4th form in The Fremennik Trials is a safe death on this guide's steps (F-0001, F-0004, F-5002).
Never go AFK on any course. Break sessions into blocks of an hour or less; handle every random event at full HP, because a random-event death is official on Hardcore Worlds (F-0003, F-3012).

Rooftops with unpublished fail damage (Canifis, Seers', Ardougne): keep HP at 30+, eat at 30, stop laps below 20. Any single fail above 12 damage means stop and ask for a re-rating (F-5367, F-5368, F-3074).

Never step into the Wilderness: no Wilderness Agility Course, no West Ardougne lever, no Ice Plateau tablets. Wilderness PvP is live on Hardcore Worlds and a PK death is official (F-5366, F-4091, F-3011).
Never use the Werewolf Agility Course at current Hitpoints and Strength (F-3067, F-3068).

Do not count on the escape crystal on Agility courses: its documented scope is a list of minigames, it does not fire while you are moving, and its status-clearing is only announced. Carry it configured, but never lower a precaution because of it (F-0015, F-3018, F-5386, F-3020).

No player-owned house, Nightmare Zone or Rogues' Den maze: all are unsafe deaths on Hardcore Worlds. Set house teleports to 'Outside'; buy Graceful from Grace without entering the maze (F-4003, F-3013, F-5358, F-4016, F-5007).
Desert: travel by magic carpet with waterskins; never walk south of Pollnivneach or along the River Elid (crocodiles, heat) (F-3078, F-5373, F-3054).
Never drink a poison chalice for a boost: it can deal 49 damage against 48 HP (F-5352).

In any quest fight, have the correct protection prayer on before the fight starts and keep at least 20 prayer points; a disconnect leaves you in combat for up to 60 seconds and logout needs 9.6 s since the last hit (F-3021, F-3022).
Never put any lamp, tome or choosable reward into Defence (build rule; F-2015, F-2038 tracks the only forced Defence XP).

Brand-new content (The Writing's on the Wall, Hardcore Worlds rules) is volatile: re-check the walkthrough and the Hardcore Worlds safe list before acting on this guide after any game update (F-2006, F-0017).

decisions.decision: Unpublished rooftop fail damage (Canifis, Seers', Ardougne) rated lethality 3 (up to ~25% HP) with knowledge 4, not UNVERIFIED_MECHANIC.
decisions.reason: The fail mechanic is documented and F-2091 states only the Werewolf deathslide can exceed current HP; only the magnitude is missing. The dispatch asks to raise knowledge and rate conservatively; the flag would assert reliance on an unverified mechanic, which the guide does not do.
alternatives_considered: lethality 2 like known small-damage courses (rejected: guessing low)
UNVERIFIED_MECHANIC flag (floor 45) on all three courses

decisions.decision: Random events treated as an unpredictability-3 interruption on every long training step and flagged HW_UNSAFE_ACTIVITY.
decisions.reason: Random events are safe for HCIM but an official death on Hardcore Worlds (F-0003, F-3012); no fact gives their damage, so no factor is reduced for handling them.
alternatives_considered: ignore random events (rejected: HCIM habit carry-over)

decisions.decision: NEW_CONTENT flag only on S01 (quest released 3 Nov 2026) and S12 (relies on the 16-day-old Hardcore Worlds form-4 safe exception).
decisions.reason: These are the steps whose danger assessment depends on under-30-day content. For other steps the Hardcore Worlds rules are applied in the conservative direction (every death unsafe), so their novelty cannot make the step more dangerous than rated; this is recorded in each note and in general_rules.
alternatives_considered: NEW_CONTENT on all 26 steps because Hardcore Worlds is new (rejected: rooftops and old quests are not new content; the floor would not reflect a real hazard)
also flag S16/S19 for their 3 Nov reward changes (rejected: XP/lamp changes do not alter the hazards)

decisions.reason: Its documented scope is a list of minigames, it does not activate while moving, and status-clearing is only announced (F-0015, F-3018, F-3020, F-5386).
